name: presh/php-evm-toolkit
description: Low-level EVM utilities for PHP — RLP encoding, EIP-155 transaction signing, ABI codec, contract deployment, and on-chain payment verification. No web3 library required.

suggest.ext-gmp: Arbitrary-precision math for token amounts beyond PHP's integer range (bcmath is used as a fallback)
suggest.ext-bcmath: Fallback arbitrary-precision math if ext-gmp is unavailable
